title: Learning 3D MRI Representations with Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning representations of visual images is a challenging task. It requires extracting abstract patterns from high-dimensional data without explicit supervision. This becomes pronounced with 3D MR imaging due to sparse features, higher dimensional inputs, and smaller datasets. Many state-of-the-art representation learning algorithms successfully rely on transformers and diffusion-based architectures. However, these methods struggle with smaller datasets. In effect, solution methods relax the problem by slicing 3D volumes and solving the problem for 2D medical imaging, resulting in a loss of spatial 3D information. We present R2RG, a representation learning method based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) honing the reconstruction task. translated_title: 使用生成对抗网络学习3D磁共振成像（MRI）表示
translated_abstract: 学习视觉图像的表示是一项具有挑战性的任务，它需要在没有显式监督的情况下从高维数据中提取抽象模式。由于特征稀疏、输入维度更高以及数据集规模较小，这一挑战在3D磁共振成像中尤为突出。许多最先进的表示学习算法成功地依赖于Transformer和基于扩散的架构，然而这些方法在小数据集上表现不佳。实际上，现有的解决方法通过将3D体数据切片来简化问题，转而解决2D医学成像问题，从而导致空间3D信息的丢失。我们提出了R2RG，一种基于卷积神经网络的表示学习方法，利用生成对抗网络来优化重建任务。我们的关键见解在于利用3D卷积神经网络的架构偏置，结合数据高效的自动编码GAN和复合损失函数来增强……
tldr: 该论文提出了R2RG方法，通过利用3D卷积神经网络的架构偏置并结合生成对抗网络优化的重建任务，在小规模3D MRI数据集上实现了保留空间3D信息的有效表示学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes R2RG, a representation learning method that exploits architectural biases in 3D CNNs combined with GAN-refined reconstruction to effectively learn 3D MRI representations from small datasets while preserving spatial 3D information.
